# ภาคสนาม · Field

> Street-level capture feeding Mot Dang, the Thai-first directory of Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai. A 360° camera on a motorbike or in hand; each frame is cut into tiles, the signs are read by Apple Vision (Thai + English) and checked by a person; names that match a Mot Dang record confirm it, names that match nothing become new records with a pin.

- Sessions: 6
- Places added: 501 · confirmed: 748 · districts reached: 6
- Photographs: 1278
- Data: https://motdang.net/field/data/places.csv, https://motdang.net/field/data/photos.json, https://motdang.net/field/data/tracks.geojson
- Licence: data and photographs CC BY 4.0 (credit NaN Peacock); code MIT
- Code: https://github.com/NaNoBotCo/field
